description: This PHP file defines a Smarty plugin function 'smarty_function_sugar_action_menu' that generates HTML code for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM action menus. It processes parameters to create nested button lists, manages configuration options, and integrates with other parts of the CRM's Smarty templating system.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_action_menu
methods.description: Generates HTML for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM action menus based on provided parameters.

methods.name: implode_r
methods.description: Helper function to recursively implode array elements with a glue string, used for assembling button HTML snippets.
